title: Safe isolation
summary: Explains the preparation, equipment and ordered process for safely isolating a circuit and proving it dead before work begins.

sections.heading: Before isolating
paragraphs: Before any isolation, make sure permission is obtained. Tell the users what safe isolation means for them and the possible disruption from losing supply, and plan temporary arrangements.
bullets: Outline to users the implications of safe isolation and the potential disruption with loss of supply.

sections.heading: Equipment needed
paragraphs: Safe isolation needs the right equipment, and the voltage indicator must be an approved one.

sections.heading: Isolation process: isolating and locking off
paragraphs: The first half of the process identifies the isolation point and secures it so that nobody can switch the supply back on.

sections.heading: Isolation process: proving dead
paragraphs: The second half proves the circuit is dead. The voltage indicator is checked on a known source before and after the tests, so you know it worked throughout.
bullets: Test the voltage indicator on a known source.
Test between all live conductors and earth.
Re-test the voltage indicator on a known source.

flashcards.front: What three things should be done before safe isolation starts?
flashcards.back: Obtain permission, outline to users the implications and potential disruption from loss of supply, and plan temporary arrangements.

flashcards.front: List the equipment needed for safe isolation.
flashcards.back: Approved voltage indicator, proving unit, lock and key device, warning notices and relevant PPE.

flashcards.front: What is the first step of the safe isolation process?
Which step comes straight after 'switch off'?
Which step follows 'lock off' in the safe isolation process?
What must you do with the voltage indicator before testing the circuit?
flashcards.back: Select an approved voltage indicator and test it on a known source.

flashcards.front: Between which conductors do you test after proving the voltage indicator?
flashcards.back: Between all live conductors, then between all live conductors and earth.

flashcards.front: What is the final step of safe isolation?
flashcards.back: Re-test the voltage indicator on a known source.

flashcards.front: Why must permission to isolate be obtained?
flashcards.back: Isolation causes potential disruption through loss of supply, so users must be told and temporary arrangements planned.

flashcards.front: What do you do straight after obtaining permission to isolate?

quiz.q: What is the first step in the safe isolation process?
quiz.why: The process starts with identifying the means of isolation.
The order is switch off, lock off, then secure key.

quiz.q: Which of these is part of the equipment list for safe isolation?
quiz.why: The equipment is an approved voltage indicator, proving unit, lock and key device, warning notices and relevant PPE.

quiz.q: What should the voltage indicator be tested on before testing the circuit?
quiz.why: It is tested on a known source, and re-tested on one after the circuit tests.

quiz.q: Which tests are made once the voltage indicator has been proved?
options: Between all live conductors and between all live conductors and earth
Between line and neutral at one socket only
Continuity of the ring final circuit
quiz.why: Tests are made between all live conductors and between all live conductors and earth.

quiz.q: What is the last step of the safe isolation process?
options: Test between all live conductors and earth
Re-test voltage indicator on a known source
quiz.why: The voltage indicator is re-tested on a known source at the end.

quiz.q: Which of the following should be done before isolating, to deal with loss of supply?
options: Leave the key in the lock
quiz.why: Users should be told of the disruption and temporary arrangements planned.

quiz.q: Which step comes after 'lock off' and before the voltage indicator is selected?
quiz.why: After lock off comes secure key, then select an approved voltage indicator.

quiz.q: In the process, when is permission to isolate obtained?
options: After identifying the means of isolation and before switching off
quiz.why: The order is identify the means of isolation, obtain permission, then switch off.
